sentences.text: The NSW Independent Commission Against Corruption prepared this guidance to help public agencies identify common corruption risks and assess their controls.
sentences.support: This publication is intended to assist NSW public sector agencies to understand the nature and prevalence of common and systemic corruption issues

sentences.text: The Commission reviewed five years of its information holdings to identify recurring types of reported misconduct.
sentences.support: the Commission has reviewed its information holdings covering a five-year period.

sentences.text: The Commission identifies human resources and staff administration as the workplace function most commonly reported by agencies, followed by allocation of funds, materials and services.
sentences.support: human resources and staff administration is the most common workplace function in matters reported by agencies.

sentences.text: Its guidance covers corruption controls, warning signs, detection and investigation across these functions and related issues such as conflicts of interest and gifts.
sentences.support: the following chapters outline a range of measures that can assist as corruption controls, as well as highlight key risks and red flags.

findings.quote: The Commission’s annual reports have consistently shown that human resources and staff administration is the most common workplace function in matters reported by agencies.

notes: Patterns concern matters reported to the Commission, not findings that every reported incident occurred. No formal numbered recommendations list.
